name: [🐰] KABOOM!
desc:
Fast-paced explosive combat.
Eliminate opponents to earn points and secure fragments for progression.

🎯 SCORING SYSTEM
- Elimination: 2 Points
- Headshot: 3 Points
- Assist: 1 Point
- 10 Points = 1 Fragment

📱COMPATIBILITY
- Full support for PC, Mobile, and Console.
